item.title: DJIA Earnings Surprises - 2026-09-13
item.description:
No DJIA component in the watchlist reported quarterly earnings within the last 10 days (2026-09-03 to 2026-09-13), so there are no earnings surprises to show this run. This is event-driven earnings data, not general market context.

Ticker Reported EPS Est EPS Actual Surprise 1w 1w vs SPY

Only the 0 most relevant rows are shown. Surprise is EPS actual vs estimate in percent. ‘1w’ is the 1-week price change since the report; ‘1w vs SPY’ is that return minus SPY’s over the same window, in points.

Data source: Yahoo Finance
